title: Line ∩ Quadratic
aliases: 聯立二元一為一次及一為二次方程
formulas: M x² + B xy + A y² + X x + Y y = K
summary: Compulsory DSE listing: intersections of a line with a circle or other conic. 219 bytes.

body.text: FMLA 01 only solves the quadratic after you have already substituted. This WebCal / IceCreamTutor version II listing (no zero-coefficient trap) takes the line Dx + Yy = C, then the conic M x² + B xy + A y² + X x + Y y = K. It prints (x₁, y₁) then (x₂, y₂). The same run also solves a 2×2 linear system if you enter zeros for the quadratic terms. ┘ is the a b/c key, not ÷, so rational answers stay as fractions.

body.label: Memory / run mode
body.text: 219 bytes (205 without storing both solution pairs) of the shared 680-byte pool. Create the slot in COMP; CMPLX if you need complex intersection points. Type ? → : ◢ Goto Lbl If Then from SHIFT 3 (P-CMD).

body.caption: Vertical line x = 2 cuts x² + y² + 3x + 7y + 2 = 0 at (2, −3) and (2, −4).

body.text: Question: Use this program to solve the case: 3x + 5y = 8 and 3x² + 4xy + 5y² + 3x + 5y = 20.

items: RCL X, RCL Y = first point. RCL A, RCL B = second point

body.text: Question: Use this program to solve the case: x = 2 and x² + y² + 3x + 7y + 2 = 0.
Given: Rewrite as x + 0y = 2 and x² + y² + 3x + 7y = −2. Version I died on the 0; this listing does not.
Question: Use this program to solve the case: Falls back to 2×2 linear.
Given: x + y = 7 and x − y = 1. Quadratic coefficients all 0.

items: Display x = 4. 【EXE】 → y = 3. Equal pair ⇒ a ‘tangent’ with only one point

body.label: Pitfalls
body.text: If the two printed points coincide, the line is tangent. Math ERROR on the second point (and the points are not equal) means only one real intersection. SHIFT MODE → → 2 (improper d/c) keeps the fractions. Source: WebCal simultaneous5a / IceCreamTutor simultaneous5a.
